..purpose: required local proof for the published GitHub Action

action.yml.purpose: verify the Action input/output contract stays preserved

jankurai-installer.sh.purpose: verify the installer's fixed signing, attestation and checksum checks

scripts/.purpose: exercise the score, policy, freshness and installer contracts

agent/.purpose: verify agent control maps stay coherent with the lanes they name

package.json.purpose: verify the test entrypoint and locked dependencies stay coherent

package-lock.json.purpose: verify the lockfile stays pinned to the HTTPS registry

README.md.purpose: verify the documented pins and lanes stay runnable

AGENTS.md.purpose: verify agent routing names the required lane

LICENSE.purpose: verify the license file is present and unmodified
